feed.title: Common Shade: State of the field
feed.subtitle: A monthly briefing on heat resilience in South and Southeast Asia: one argument about what changed, what the evidence establishes, what it could mean for decisions, and what to watch next.

entry.title: State of the field, November 2026: A heat rule for outdoor work is scheduled to take effect; whether rules reach workers is not yet visible
entry.summary: Singapore's heat stress measures for outdoor work, announced on 28 August 2026, are scheduled to become mandatory on 1 December 2026. Two further developments on heat at work were reviewed this month, but rest on secondary reports. None of this yet shows whether rules are applied on worksites, or whom they reach. Reporting period 1 to 15 November 2026; evidence cut-off 15 November 2026.

entry.title: State of the field, October 2026: Support announced for the work between institutions, with amounts and delivery still to show
entry.summary: Two philanthropic announcements this year name support for shared evidence and coordination across institutions, the roles our funding trace found thinnest. Both are announcements: neither amount was disclosed, and no payment has been verified. Reporting period 1 to 31 October 2026; evidence cut-off 31 October 2026. This edition has been corrected; see its revisions.
